author: worker_3
belief: KRS 431.220(1)(b) states: "Prisoners who receive a death sentence prior to March 31, 1998, shall choose the method of execution..." The statutory cutoff is based on when the death sentence was RECEIVED, not when the crime was COMMITTED.

author: worker_3
belief: The claim states electrocution is available to those "whose capital crimes were committed prior to March 31, 1998" but the actual statute (KRS 431.220) specifies "Prisoners who receive a death sentence prior to March 31, 1998." These are different legal criteria - the claim misstates the eligibility criterion.
